name: eval2 fix: the stool drawn alone on white (MOTH-116)

cases.prompt:
Style: a polished, finished illustration drawn for a game, not a picture book for toddlers; clean dark-ink outlines on everything, a shadow side on every object and soft cast shadows from one light source, so things sit solidly on their surfaces; smooth colour with gentle shading, a faint paper-grain texture and a gentle vignette at the edges. Bright and clear, not hazy or dark. The attached picture shows the step stool in the room: draw exactly this stool, same wood, same shape, same angle. Draw it alone on a pure flat white background: no floor, no wall, no shadow on the ground, no frame, nothing else in the picture; the gaps between its legs and under its steps are white. The object fills most of the frame. No words, letters, numbers or symbols anywhere in the picture.

The object: the small two-step wooden step stool from the attached picture, seen from the front and a little to the side.
cases.note: MOTH-116: the stool's icon and the stool at the wardrobe, drawn on white, never lifted from a wall
